query: So how do I tell on cars used by my boss?
reference_answer:
Reporting Unauthorized Use of Government Vehicles:
Report misuse of government vehicles to the Tamil Nadu Police Department's helpline or the Vigilance Department. Provide vehicle details, including number plate, location, and time of incident.
answer: To tell if a car belongs to your boss, look for company logos or stickers on the dashboard or door panels. Check if the vehicle has matching tires and matching spare tire. [Document 1]
